notes.subject: the I-AM
notes.rationale: היות אהיה כמוך: 'you thought that I am altogether like you' (relative sense) vs 'you thought the I-AM to be like you' — אהיה echoes the divine self-naming of Exodus 3:14, kept visible.

notes.subject: ⟨it⟩
notes.rationale: אערכה has no stated object; the 'setting in order' (of the charges) is supplied.

notes.subject: אהיה
notes.rationale: God's silence led the wicked to deem the I-AM like themselves; the name-echo of Exodus 3:14 frames the rebuke.

notes.subject: the wicked
notes.rationale: Direct second-person rebuke from Elohim continuing the courtroom speech of Psalm 50.

translation: These things you did, and I kept silent; you thought the I-AM to be like you — I will rebuke you, and set ⟨it⟩ before your eyes.

tokens.gloss: and I will set in order
